what: Pressing the menu button turns on a full-screen black contrast stage panel in .5s ease, and the link rows slide in from 20px to the right and wide letter-spacing (.375rem) into place at tight spacing (.07rem) in .5s ease-in-out — the first row after .1s, then each following row .05s later. Because the spacing tightens too, the lines feel like they’re gathering in. Closing fades only the panel out in .5s. Clicking a link or pressing Esc closes it.

options.[data-fx-part=toggle]: Toggle button — the part adds aria-expanded. The button shape (hamburger → X) is up to the user via [data-fx~=with track-in-menu].is-open
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Link rows that enter in sequence (li or a)
options.--fx-fill / --fx-on: Panel color and text color (via style), default --kf-contrast-bg · --kf-contrast-ink
options.--fx-dur / --fx-ease: Panel turn-on duration · curve, default .5s ease
options.--fx-item-dur / --fx-item-ease: Link duration and curve, default .5s ease-in-out
options.--fx-first / --fx-each: First-row delay · gap between rows, default .1s · .05s

note: The panel is position: fixed, so if an ancestor of the attached element has a transform, it gets trapped inside — place it outside the header row or clear the ancestor transform.

from.where: shared.js·shared.css .sk-nav (phone menu at 1080 and below — original style.css .l-header_nav.is-open: opacity·visibility transition all .5s ease, li animation .5s ease-in-out forwards (from translateX(20px)·letter-spacing .375rem·transparent), each li with animation-delay .1s + .05s steps)
